svg.title: Tran Kim Dat’s technology stack
svg.desc: TypeScript; JavaScript; Python; C#; Dart; PHP; SQL; React; Next.js; Vite; Tailwind CSS; shadcn/ui; Ant Design; Radix UI; GSAP: UI motion; Three.js: 3D game rendering; PixiJS: 2D game rendering; Flutter; React Native; Expo: Mobile + push; FastAPI; NestJS; Fastify: API server; ASP.NET Core; Laravel; Strapi: Headless CMS; SignalR: Real-time chat; PostgreSQL; MongoDB; Redis: Cache + limits; SQLAlchemy: Python ORM; Drizzle ORM: TypeScript ORM; TypeORM: NestJS ORM; EF Core: .NET ORM; Firebase: Push messaging; Gemini Grounded Search; Exa: Web research; Tavily: Source search; Langfuse: AI tracing; OpenTelemetry: Distributed tracing; Inngest: Durable workflows; Docker: App containers; GitHub Actions: CI checks; Render: App hosting; Neon: Postgres + Auth; Vercel: Hosting + storage; Cloudinary: Media delivery; FFmpeg: Video processing; Resend: Contact emails; Upstash: Rate limiting; Zod: Schema validation; Pytest: API tests; Vitest: Frontend tests; Playwright: Browser tests.
